# QueryExecutionOptions

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.Query.QueryExecutionOptions`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Per-query execution options that affect how the query is sent to Dataverse. These options map to OrganizationRequest.Parameters keys that modify server-side behavior (e.g., bypassing plugins or flows).

### Properties

#### BypassFlows

```text
System.Boolean BypassFlows { get; set; }
```

When true, adds SuppressCallbackRegistrationExpanderJob = true to the request, preventing Power Automate flows from triggering for the query. Set by the -- ppds:BYPASS_FLOWS query hint.


#### BypassPlugins

```text
System.Boolean BypassPlugins { get; set; }
```

When true, adds BypassCustomPluginExecution = true to the request, skipping synchronous plugin execution for the query. Set by the -- ppds:BYPASS_PLUGINS query hint.
